title: Dynamic Common-Opponent Hodge-Plackett-Luce
primary_hypothesis: For current-race horse pairs that have never met, shared-opponent paths contain pair-specific time-safe information beyond scalar dynamic PL, R0-clean, and the terminal close win market.

already_tested_do_not_repeat: statistical-mechanics M1 pair coupling term in the PL partition function (style-based; umaren ECE -33%, zero realized ROI)
prior_art_boundary.equivalence_warning: A single scalar theta per horse with logistic pair probabilities is already implicit in EXP02 and is not a new experiment.
prior_art_boundary.new_component: Keep common-opponent-derived d_ij as a target-pair-specific antisymmetric matrix until weighted Hodge projection at prediction time.
unverified_not_failed: curl component or identity pair coupling carried directly into race probability (not implemented / not tested; no EXP17 rescue under the freeze rule; current data insufficient to start a new experiment because 84.7% of used edges in 2022 (78.8% in 2019-2023) are single meetings)

equivalence_result_stage0.E0_A: Hodge projection output is one scalar per horse by construction; pair-specific evidence survives only in the projection residual. The race-level probability arm is therefore in the same model family as EXP02 (different estimator only). Verified synthetically: gradient input returns theta (max err 2.3e-13), pure curl input returns s=0.
equivalence_result_stage0.E0_B: 2022 label-free: Var(d_ij - b*dmu_ij) real / BT-null mean = 0.840, CI95 [0.825, 0.856]; preregistered FAIL rule upper < 1.10 satisfied.
equivalence_result_stage0.E0_C: median 47% of pair-evidence sum of squares is discarded by the projection.

population.horse_key: 血統登録番号 as string
race_rules: exclude DNF-containing races from formal race-level Gates (proxy: master rows < 出走頭数)
omit tied pairs from pairwise labels
population.dnf_caveat: Result-conditioned DNF exclusion is temporary until a full-starter scoring contract exists.

id_audit.note: 同一 ID に複数馬名 = 衝突 (fail-closed 対象)。同一馬名に複数 ID は正常 (馬名 join 禁止の根拠)

time_safety.update: batch after final race of the day

pair_model.primary_sample: never-met current-race pairs with at least one eligible shared opponent
pair_model.aggregate: weighted mean over shared opponents using frozen reliability, recency, and condition-similarity weights
pair_model.missing_rule: missing evidence remains missing and is not a zero observation
pair_model.direct_meetings: reported separately and excluded from the primary mechanism sample

grid_that_would_have_been_frozen_on_le_2.note: 未実施。E0 FAIL のため Stage 1 に進まない

projection.constraint: sum scores equals zero within each connected component

equivalence_hard_stop: algebraically reduces to one scalar rating per horse
label-free 2022 race scores are an affine transform of EXP02 ability within frozen tolerance

power.method: effect injection on label-free historical race structures
power.mechanism_floor: must be fixed after Stage 0 power audit and before 2019-2023 outcome evaluation
power.inference_unit_note: 開催日 (暦日, 540 days in 2019-2023). EXP16A used venue-day rid16[:10]; EXP17 pools venues on the same day (more conservative).

year_y_rules: graph uses races strictly before each target day
all learned parameters use years before Y
no 2022 learned value is applied retrospectively to 2019-2021
rolling_protocol.holdout_caveat: retrospective crossfit, not a pristine external holdout

arms.M3_BASE: close offset plus M1, M2, and graph structural/confound controls without path value
arms.M4_PATH: close offset plus projected common-opponent path score only
arms.M5_FULL: M3 plus projected path score and preregistered path uncertainty terms
arms.PRE_FULL: historical_pre_snapshot offset plus M5 non-market terms

placebos.pass_rule: real improvement must exceed the 97.5th percentile of P1 and of P2, and exceed P3

P1_degree_preserving_identity_rewire.operation: for each target horse h, resample opponent identities c from the cell pool with replacement, count = degree(h); keep edge attributes (date, won, surf, dband)
preserved: age band x career band composition
broken: common-opponent structure (n_common changes; recorded per draw and controlled in M3_BASE)
P1_degree_preserving_identity_rewire.cells: year x surface x field-size band x age band x career-starts band (target horse)

P2_direction_null.operation: flip won with probability 0.5 per (h,c) edge; endpoints, n_hc and coverage unchanged

P3_identity_free_control.operation: replace d_ij by a function of degree difference, career-starts difference, rest-days difference, recency and component size fitted on <= Y-1

placebos.comparison_to_EXP12: EXP12 replaced horse-row aggregated opponent-strength means via a CLT approximation (3 mean features, 1000 draws) preserving degree/age-career stratum/missing rate. EXP17 P1 resamples identities on the edge list without approximation, additionally preserving edge age, W/L and condition match; only common-opponent structure is (intentionally) broken.

G1_mechanism.comparison: PATH pair probability minus M1_DYNPL pair probability on never-met pairs with common opponents
G1_mechanism.metric: binary pairwise logloss aggregated within race then meeting day
requirements: all leave-one-year-out CI95 upper below zero
real effect beats all placebo 97.5th percentiles
effect meets frozen Stage 0 mechanism floor
G1_mechanism.fail_action: stop without PageRank, longer paths, embedding, or GNN rescue

grading.DETECT: CI95 upper < 0 and 4/5 years and 4/5 seeds and all LOO CI95 upper < 0 and beats P1,P2 97.5th percentile and beats P3

grades.PASS-PRACTICAL: CI95 upper below -0.005 plus all stability and placebo rules
grades.PASS-SIGNAL: CI95 upper below zero but not below -0.005 plus all stability and placebo rules
grades.FAIL: CI includes zero or any stability/placebo rule fails

G2_terminal_close_residual.progression: only PASS-PRACTICAL may request a separately reviewed practical stage

G3_time_of_information.interpretation: pre-market improvement without terminal-close residual is timing information, not demonstrated tradable value

stop_rules: degree, career starts, rest days, or missingness explains improvement
result depends on one year or one small subgroup
prohibitions: ROI or payout evaluation before practical terminal-close pass and new review
post-result rescue with PageRank, longer paths, embedding, GNN, new lookbacks, or new populations
freeze_policy: After review, record version and commit. Any later change requires a new version and pre-result commit with reason and affected fields.
fail_statement: 事前固定した時点安全な 2-hop 共通対戦馬表現は、対象母集団・期間・統制の下で必要なペア固有情報を追加しなかった。

conclusion_scope.revised: 2026-09-25 (wording only; gates, thresholds, population, arms, placebo, stop rules and results unchanged)
conclusion_scope.closed: EXP12 で検証した 1-hop 表現と、EXP17 で検証した時点安全な共通対戦 2-hop 表現＋Hodge スカラー射影を閉じた
conclusion_scope.not_claimed: 対戦相手 identity 系全体を閉じたとは主張しない
conclusion_scope.s_vs_mu: s と μ の差は、事前固定した超過分散基準では null 抽選ノイズを上回らず、追加の pair 固有状態として Stage 1 へ進める根拠にならなかった
conclusion_scope.untested: curl 成分または identity pair coupling を直接 race 確率へ運ぶ方式は未実装・未検証 (失敗ではない)
conclusion_scope.data_limit: 使用辺の 84.7% (2022; 2019-2023 は 78.8%) が対戦 1 回であり、現データで新実験を開始する根拠は不足している

freeze_record.rule: No further change of gates, thresholds, population, arms, placebo, stop rules under EXP17. Reopening requires a new experiment number and an unused evaluation plan.
